site.site_description: DXD Architects is an architecture, interiors and building studio in Calicut, Kerala, led by Ar. Mansoor Anchukandan.
site.demo_notice: A website concept prepared by RJ for DXD Architects. Projects and photographs from DXD's own LinkedIn posts and The Architects Diary.
site.footer_about_text: Architects, builders and interiors. Homes, clinics and studios across Kerala.

home.title: Architecture, interiors and building in Kerala
home.hero_title: Homes and spaces made for Kerala.
home.hero_description: Tropical homes, calm clinics and a fashion studio, designed and built by one team in Calicut.
home.material_description: Soft plaster curves at Mankasurath. Light, calm tones at Dr. Saleem's. Laterite and exposed concrete at Orchard House. Each palette suits how the space is used.
home.craft_detail_description: At Box over the Wall in Koduvally, stone cladding meets clean white walls, inclined angles and louvers.
home.craft_space_title: Open, with privacy where it counts
home.craft_space_description: At Noushad Residence in Tavanur, plants and design elements quietly separate private rooms from shared ones.
home.work_description: Six projects across Kerala, from a 775 sq ft fashion studio to a 4,305 sq ft home.
home.service_title: One studio, from plan to build
home.service_one_body: Homes planned around Kerala's light, rain and greenery.
home.service_two_body: Clinics, studios and homes, detailed down to the furniture, lighting and finishes.
home.service_three_body: The studio also builds, so the design carries through to the finished site.
home.service_four_body: Retail and healthcare spaces planned for smooth daily work and a calm visitor experience.
home.origin_title: A Calicut studio working across Kerala
home.origin_description: DXD Architects designs and builds homes, clinics and commercial spaces from Calicut, with projects in Wayanad, Malappuram and Kannur.
home.origin_description_two: Principal architect Ar. Mansoor Anchukandan leads the studio. Each project starts from the client's own ideas and the setting around the site.

work.title: Projects
work.page_lead: Interiors, clinics and homes across Calicut, Malappuram, Wayanad and Thalassery.

studio.title: About
studio.page_lead: Architects, builders and interior designers working as one team in Calicut.
studio.statement_body: The studio likes to build a design from the client's own ideas and point of view, then fit it to the land and the people around it.
studio.light_body: Principal Architect of DXD Architects. Leads the studio's architecture, interiors and build work from Calicut.
studio.texture_body: Design and construction under one roof, so the drawings and the finished building match.
studio.proportion_body: Sloped roofs, greenery and local materials like laterite, chosen for Kerala's climate.
studio.closing_body: From an 894 sq ft clinic to a 4,305 sq ft family home, every project gets the same attention.

process.title: Approach
process.page_lead: Each project begins with the client's vision and the character of the site.
process.step_one_body: Understand how the family or business lives and works, and what they want the space to feel like.
process.step_two_body: Light, rain, views and greenery shape the plan, so the building sits naturally in its setting.
process.step_three_body: The same studio carries the design through construction and interiors, down to the finishes.
process.closing_body: Spaces made to suit the people who use them and the place they stand in.

contact.title: Contact
contact.page_lead: Call the studio with your site, your plans and your timeline.
contact.contact_note: Demo note: this concept site uses the studio's published phone number.

projects.name: Mankasurath
projects.tagline: A fashion studio built on soft curves and red accents.
projects.alt: Mankasurath studio with red garments on display rails against warm beige walls
projects.intro: Mankasurath is a fashion design studio in Calicut. Display, fitting, work and storage share one open floor.
projects.story: Curved workstations and soft transitions between zones remove harsh corners. A warm beige textured wall sets a calm backdrop for the clothes.
projects.detail_caption: Arched niches and red accents frame the garments on display.
projects.detail: Recessed lights and spotlights around the podium pick out the colour and texture of each garment. Red accents draw the eye to key displays.

projects.name: Dr. Ashoora's Dentistry
projects.tagline: A calm clinic in a converted shop.
projects.alt: Reception desk at Dr. Ashoora's Dentistry with green shelving and timber panelling
projects.intro: This multi-specialty dental clinic is a refurbished retail space in the town of Edavannappara.
projects.story_title: Away from the stress of a clinic.
projects.story: The design steps away from the usual hospital feel. Visually connected rooms make the clinic feel open and clear.
projects.detail_caption: A treatment room with white marble, timber and soft daylight.
projects.detail: Rounded furniture and ceiling edges keep the reception welcoming. The treatment rooms take straighter lines, suited to precise work.

projects.name: Noushad Residence
projects.tagline: A modern mixed-roof home close to family.
projects.alt: Noushad Residence with sloped tiled roofs and white walls among trees
projects.intro: A secluded modern home on a 38.7 cent plot in Tavanur, built next to the client's family house.
projects.story_title: Close to family, with room of its own.
projects.story: The client, an electrical engineer living abroad, wanted to stay close to his roots without losing private space. The house sits beside the family home with no wall between them.
projects.detail_caption: Mixed roof forms and greenery around the house.
projects.detail: The plan feels open at first glance. Plants and design elements quietly hide the private rooms from the shared ones.

projects.name: Dr. Saleem's Dentistry
projects.tagline: A clinic that feels like home.
projects.alt: Reception and waiting area at Dr. Saleem's Dentistry in light Scandinavian tones
projects.intro: The client asked for a dental clinic where patients feel at home. The design mixes a classic style with Scandinavian calm.
projects.story: Pale tones, timber and soft light run from the reception to the treatment rooms.
projects.detail_caption: A treatment room planned for an easy daily workflow.
projects.detail: The layout supports an efficient workflow for the dental team, while keeping the comfort patients notice.

projects.name: Box over the Wall
projects.tagline: A minimal home in stone and white.
projects.alt: Box over the Wall house with a white upper volume over stone-clad walls
projects.intro: This home grew out of an existing structural frame in Koduvally.
projects.story: A plain rectangular plan is shaped by inclined angles and louvers into a modern house.
projects.detail_caption: Natural stone cladding against clean white walls.
projects.detail: Natural stone cladding contrasts with white walls. Greenery and touches of wood soften the concrete edges.

projects.name: Orchard House
projects.tagline: A tropical home in a one-acre wood.
projects.alt: Orchard House with sloped roofs and laterite cladding surrounded by tall trees
projects.intro: Orchard House sits in the middle of a one-acre wood in Wayanad, with green views on every side.
projects.story: Grey tones, exposed concrete and laterite brick cladding give the house its contrast. The plan follows Vastu and the cardinal directions.
projects.detail_caption: Laterite, concrete and sloped roofs among the trees.
projects.detail: Through the day, light and shadow move across the textured walls and keep the house calm for the family.
